It's the Iglewicz & Hoaglin (1993) threshold: a measured request's metric is treated as a robust outlier when

```
|x - median| > ROBUST_Z × max(1.4826 × MAD, ROBUST_FLOOR × median)
```

i.e. `|0.6745 (x − median) / MAD| > 3.5`, judged within arm, case and request slot, requiring at least `ROBUST_MIN` (3) values in the group. A pass containing such an outlier row is dropped whole from the summary (confirm tier only).
